executiveSummary: CISA warns of active, AI-assisted probing and access attempts against Siemens S7-200/300/400/1200/1500 PLCs (TCP/102 S7comm), increasing risk of process manipulation where devices are internet-exposed or poorly segmented. Security Advisory Multiple gateway/drive issues elevate OT risk: unauthenticated takeover paths on Advantech EKI-1242 gateways; unsigned firmware/application exposure on Danfoss iC7 VFDs; and RCE on Autel OCPP EV chargers-collectively enable disruption or pivots across industrial networks. CISA Bulletin CISA Bulletin CISA Bulletin OT-adjacent protocol libraries under pressure: Eclipse Milo (OPC UA) vulnerabilities impact authorization, crypto, and availability across IIoT stacks; urgent patching and hardening of policies/roles is advised. CISA Bulletin Cloud-managed infrastructure exploited: attackers abused GL.iNet GoodCloud to push malware to routers/KVMs, creating credible enterprise-to-OT pivot risk where these devices sit near engineering assets. View Article Maritime/transport risk: suspected Iran-nexus actors reportedly exploited FortiGate to target up to 50 vessels, with indicators of OT exposure (propulsion access) and crew intimidation. View Article Enterprise vectors with OT spillover potential: Webworm-modified SoftEther VPN bridges for stealth access; Zimbra XSS zero-day by Void Blizzard; and an active Gunra ransomware campaign exploiting FortiOS-together drive identity and perimeter hardening urgency. View Article Security Advisory Security Advisory PHP zero-days are exploited in the wild against public-facing portals and appliances; national CERTs urge immediate patching and compromise assessment to prevent enterprise-to-OT lateral movement. View Article Security Advisory

items: China-nexus "Webworm" modified SoftEther VPN Bridge for covert RAS under benign branding; hunt for renamed services and atypical SoftEther HTTP paths. View Article
Void Blizzard leveraged a Zimbra webmail XSS zero-day (view-based) to exfiltrate mail, GAL, and MFA artifacts. Security Advisory

relevance: The heaviest concentration of risk centers on: (1) direct manipulation potential of field devices (Siemens PLCs, Danfoss iC7 drives); (2) industrial gateway weaknesses that straddle protocol and management planes (Advantech EKI-1242, OPC UA implementations); and (3) enterprise edge exploitation (FortiOS, vCenter, Zimbra, cloud-managed routers/KVMs) that can provide lateral movement toward engineering workstations and control networks. The combination of in-the-wild exploitation, KEV additions, and high-impact OT CVEs sustains a HIGH threat posture.

items: Siemens S7 PLC ecosystem - active reconnaissance/exploitation risks (hardening required). CISA
OPC UA (Eclipse Milo) - multiple auth/crypto/DoS flaws; library updates and policy tightening. CISA
Advantech EKI-1242 - unauth administrative actions & OPC UA DoS. CISA
Danfoss iC7 drives - unsigned firmware/application path. CISA
MQTT libumqtt - memory corruption/DoS in client lib ( CISA ICS
FortiOS/SSL-VPN - exploited by ransomware & state actors; isolate and patch rapidly. CISA
Zimbra XSS zero-day (view-based) - mail/GAL/MFA exfil risk. CISA
vCenter activity - auth bypasses under active exploitation; treat as Tier-0 and harden SSO. Recap
GL.iNet GoodCloud - cloud-to-device backdoor path abused; reimage and rotate credentials. THN
PHP zero-days - active exploitation for web shells and staging. Krebs

descriptions: Initial Access: Exploitation of internet-facing VPNs/webmail (T1190), cloud-managed device channels, and protocol endpoints (OPC UA, OCPP, S7comm).
Execution/Persistence: Webshells on PHP stacks; modified SoftEther VPN bridges; device firmware/app uploads; scheduled tasks/cron on routers/KVMs.
Privilege Escalation/Lateral Movement: FortiOS to VDI/AD; RDP/SMB with Impacket; pivot from compromised routers/KVMs to engineering hosts.
Collection/Exfiltration: Zimbra view-based exfil via DNS/HTTPS; cloud sinks (MEGA/OneDrive/SharePoint); OCPP manipulation for EVSE telemetry.
Impact: PLC write attempts (S7comm function codes); drive parameter manipulation; EVSE remote disable; DoS on MQTT/OPC UA chains.

outlook72h: Remove any remaining Internet exposure of PLC/OPC UA and engineering services; verify via external scanning. Patch/mitigate KEV-listed items (FortiOS, Mail Assure, MONAI Label) and assess for pre-patch compromise artifacts. Block or rate-limit TCP/5058 on Advantech gateways; deep-log access attempts; enable OPC UA auth. Audit vCenter/SSO for rogue tokens/users; restrict mgmt networks; enable lockdown per vendor guidance. Reimage and re-enroll GL.iNet routers/KVMs where compromise indicators exist; rotate all associated credentials/keys. Implement S7comm-aware detections on ICS IDS; alert on PUT/GET or off-window PLC writes.
